about: Message search, as Slack writes it, turned into the query the SDK's search index parses (Tantivy's query grammar, with body, sender and date fields). parse reads Slack's in: and from: out of typed text: a room by its sidebar name, with an optional # or @ and quotes around spaces; a person by Matrix ID or me. What doesn't resolve stays in the text. query turns text, a mode, and the From, In and date filters into the index query, or null when there is nothing to search; the In filter narrows hits rather than the query. Dates count from the start of the day that far back, computed here in UTC from now. highlights lists the words of body a search would mark, in order: whole words the query names, in any case, without AND, OR and NOT in query mode.
